reasons.claim: Notification is a 0.78 ha polygon (regeneration felling, notified 2026-10-02); no overlap with completed fellings, so not ALREADY_FELLED.
No eligible species recorded inside or within 250 m; the 250 m ring holds 1 record with 0 red-listed species.

Two eligible site-bound VU species recorded 520-653 m away, both in 2025 with 25 m uncertainty: Goodyera repens (520 m; lack of dead wood, increased openness listed as threats) and Skeletocutis brevispora (653 m; lack of dead wood, lack of continuity forest, soil disturbance listed). This triggers MEDIUM (beyond 250 m, within 1000 m).

Effort is adequate (93 records, 64th percentile, above the county median of 66), so the lack of near-site records is somewhat more informative than at a low-effort site; within 250 m only 1 record and 1 observation day exist, against a county median of 3 records.

uncertainties: Records 500-650 m away do not show that these species occur in the notified stand.
Near-site effort within 250 m (1 record) is below the county median of 3, so absence close to the polygon is weakly informative.
Records are only points; habitat similarity between the polygon and the record locations is not established by these tools.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occupies the polygon.

next_action: A reviewer should check whether the polygon's forest connects to the habitat around the 2025 records of Goodyera repens and Skeletocutis brevispora, and consider a field check before felling starts.
